x-changelog.summary: Group-managed memberships are protected from vendor removal
x-changelog.description:
When the Groups feature is enabled, removing a Vendor from a project whose
membership is managed by Groups now returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`
with a structured error (`code: MEMBERSHIP_GROUP_MANAGED`,
`hint: group_managed`) instead of removing the Vendor. Behavior is
unchanged when the feature is off.
